scientific_integrity: The all-parameter classification follows from a written proof. Exhaustive small-size tests corroborate but are not substituted for infinite proofs. No independent validation was conducted.
scientific_limitations: The proof applies to labeled two-row rectangular bands over characteristic-zero coefficients; it does not classify arbitrary multirow rectangular bands, unlabeled orbits of Schur rings, or positive-characteristic degeneracies. Equivalence with unindexed earlier results remains a possible literature risk.
title: Schur-ring classification of two-row rectangular bands
